correctness.rationale: The ordinary cut convention gives 400 facets from the 400 disconnected triples. A fresh reconstruction (/workspace/branches/65c0e165-0142-42dc-abdf-6faab9f7f763/independent_reproduction.py) matched all 65,199 faces, 32,591 augmented pairs, the acyclic sort of 519,792 incidences, the 16 critical eleven-cells and single critical twelve-cell, and the signed boundary vector of gcd 2. The ordinary unaugmented model adds one critical vertex; Hurewicz identifies the attaching map with its degree vector on the eleven-sphere wedge, so unimodular reduction gives precisely the Moore summand and fifteen spheres. Integral homology and nonshellability follow. The reproduction also gives Smith factors 1^104,2 for the dual cycle-lattice matrix. Independently, each induced path triangle and each square diagonal lies in a unique square tetrahedron. Collapsing each tetrahedron along one triangle and then the remaining triangle on that diagonal along the diagonal leaves the square triangulated on the other diagonal. This collapses the dual onto the cubical two-skeleton of the antipodal five-cube boundary quotient. Its fundamental group is Z/2 (the covering two-skeleton is simply connected) and its Euler characteristic is 16-40+40=16. This explains the dual computation structurally. The frozen scripts and outputs are supporting evidence, not the independent computation.
